message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 in Europeans**

| Population (European) | Allele | Frequency (≈) |
|------------------------|--------|---------------|
| Non‑Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **C** (minor allele) | **~12 %** |
| Non‑Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v3.1.1) | **C** | **~11–13 %** |
| 1000 Genomes Project (EUR superpopulation) | **C** | **~10–12 %** |

> **Interpretation**  
> The rs7412 SNP is located in the APOE gene. The **C** allele (minor allele) is part of the APOE ε2 haplotype, which occurs in roughly 10–12 % of individuals of European ancestry. The complementary **T** allele is the major allele, present in ~88–90 % of the population.

> **Sources**  
> * gnomAD (Genome Aggregation Database) – v2.1.1 and v3.1.1 allele frequencies.  
> * 1000 Genomes Project – EUR superpopulation allele counts.  

> **Note**  
> Frequencies can vary slightly between sub‑populations (e.g., Northern vs. Southern Europeans) and between different reference datasets. The values above represent the most widely cited averages for the broader European population.
